acnh.intro: Tangy is a peppy cat villager in the who appears in all games to date. Her name is derived from ''tangerine'', a citrus fruit similar to oranges, which relates to her appearance, as well as ''tangy'', an adjective used to describe those fruits. Her Japanese catchphrase, "," is a type of mandarin orange.
acnh.appearance: Tangy is an orange cat shaped like citrus — a green leaf on her head similar to Tank's style, pink inner ears, and southeast-angled eyes that turn cross-eyed when she looks up or down. Small indents pock her body like peel texture; tangerine, clementine, and orange notes explain her name in one sunny glance.
acnh.personality: Tangy stays peppy-upbeat — good moods, easy befriending, cute bugs and fish requests, and magazine daydreams shared with other stylish villagers who read unseen fashion pages. She jokes about feeling bloated after absurd snacking, flares up fast, then forgets why, attention span short as her temper is quick. Fame fantasies pop up now and then, dreams of spotlight she shares with peppy neighbors who chase the same glitter. Normal, lazy, and peppy villagers suit her; snooty and cranky types groan at the sparkle she refuses to dim. Short fuse, shorter grudge — she keeps the island tasting bright through every season ahead.

villagerInfo.quote: When life gives you lemons, make lemonade!
